authentication: Bearer when configured; obtain credentials through authorized operator channel

services.name: A2A Interaction Trace
services.description: Evaluate one submitted task and return execution metrics, source confidence and risk flags. No payment verification or global reputation.

services.name: A2A Interaction Risk Report
services.description: Return the same single-task metrics with meaning, not_meaning and bilingual explanations in interpretation.flags. No extra evidence or provenance upgrade.

purchase_flow: Optional POST /v1/quotes/{quote_id}/negotiate {buyer_offer}; consume decision, never invent acceptance
POST /v1/orders {quote_id,buyer_id,service_id,amount,idempotency_key,input}; amount is accepted final_price or quote ask_price
input_boundary: 1 to 200 events for one task and one subject. Public events are self_reported; unknown fields discarded before persistence. No raw prompt or full artifact required. Hashes/references are stored, not independently verified.
